title: 6640--FY26| Thyroid Cancer Molecular Test| Orlando VA & San Juan|  New Requirement
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.248-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 8 (36C248)
detail_text: The Caribbean VA Healthcare System and Orlando VA Healthcare System intends to solicit and award an acquisition for Thyroid Cancer Molecular Test, as defined in the Statement of Work (SOW). This will be a Base of 12-months and Four (4) 12-month options. This requirement is solicited as Unrestricted. The Primary North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this acquisition is 621511 Medical Laboratories, with a related small business size standard of $41.5 Million, and FSC/PSC is 6640. This solicitation is a Request for Quote (RFQ), for a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) requirement contract, which will be advertised as unrestricted on or before 26 February 2026, via sam.gov website. The solicitation and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2025-06 10/01/2025. To be eligible for award, prospective offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) Internet site, www.sam.gov. Amendments to the RFQ will be posted to this website only. It is the responsibility of the quoter to review the web page for notice of amendments, updates, or changes to the solicitation. No hard copies will be mailed. The contractor must ensure that we receive the proposal on time; NO late proposals will be accepted/ considered. Any questions or concerns regarding this solicitation should be submitted no later than 03/02/2026 at 12:00 PM EST. No further questions will be accepted after that date and time. Please submit questions in writing via e-mail to the Contract Specialist, Yolanda Glover, at yolanda.glover@va.gov. All quotations for this solicitation shall be submitted no later than 03/09/2026 at 4:00 PM EST. Please submit all responses to the Contract Specialist, Yolanda Glover, at yolanda.glover@va.gov Late submissions shall be treated in accordance with the solicitation provision at FAR 52.212-1(c). *Note* To prepare / complete a Quote, See Offerors Checklist under 52.212-2 Evaluation Commercial Items.
